answer: A free extra identity is the cheapest attack, so price each seat with a refundable deposit larger than the saffron any one identity could skim by cheating. The honest agent stakes once at dawn and withdraws it whole later, a slab of marble returned uncracked. A farm must bond every clone separately, and since a caught fraud forfeits more than it can steal, each added head turns profit into loss — the deposit makes the swarm pay to exist.
